name: FRED — Federal Reserve Economic Data
agency: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

endpoints.description: Observation values for an economic data series by series_id

limits.notes: 120 requests/minute per key. Default response is XML — request file_type=json explicitly.

llmDocs.summary: US and international macroeconomic time series: GDP, inflation, interest rates, employment, money supply.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Identify a series_id (e.g. GDP, CPIAUCSL, UNRATE) then call /series/observations?series_id=...&file_type=json. Use /series/search to discover series_ids.
gotchas: Must pass file_type=json or you get XML
api_key is required on every call
Series IDs are case-sensitive uppercase codes

compliance.redistributionNotes: Free API key required; underlying series may carry third-party copyright/licensing — check series-level notes before redistribution.
